reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis targets the wrong alloy system (NbMoTaVW instead of NbMoTaW) and relies on a VEC-based ductility criterion that is not reliably predictive for refractory HEAs, with no mechanistic link to irradiation resistance.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares the wrong baseline and does not include high-temperature or irradiation assessments, so it cannot falsify the stated hypothesis about preserving those properties.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a different alloy system and omits the required high-temperature and irradiation evaluations, making it irrelevant to the research question.
